title: Add an option to let users select the main date display (Gregorian or alternate calendar).
line: The panel clock can now show its date in the alternate calendar (Persian, Hebrew, Chinese…) by picking "Alternate calendar" as the date format.
explanation: The Digital Clock formatted the panel date only with the Gregorian calendar; the Alternate Calendar add-on's date appeared only in the tooltip and popup. Also, after changing the calendar system, already loaded dates never refreshed: the plugin's updateSettings() reloaded an empty range, and the calendar model never let a label be replaced by one of the same priority. Date format now has an "Alternate calendar" entry (shown when the add-on is enabled) that puts the add-on's date for today on the panel, falling back to the short date when the add-on is off; the plugin now reloads its range on settings change and the model lets a plugin replace its own labels, so the panel follows a calendar system change at once.

commits.message:
applets/digitalclock: allow showing the date in the alternate calendar

The panel always showed the Gregorian date, even with the Alternate
Calendar add-on on. Date format now offers the alternate calendar, and
the calendar model lets a plugin replace its own sub-labels on reload.

BUG: 486561

alternatecalendar: reload dates when the calendar system changes

updateSettings() cleared the last loaded range in init() and then asked
to load that now empty range, so open views kept showing the old
calendar's dates. Remember the range before clearing it, then reload it.

BUG: 486561

media.caption: Persian alternate calendar on: the popup shows 3 Azar 1405, the panel still shows 11/24/26
With Date format "Alternate calendar", the panel shows 3 Azar, 1405 too
New "Alternate calendar" choice, listed when the add-on is enabled
Changing the calendar system and pressing Apply updates the panel date right away (Persian → Hebrew → Chinese)
